messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Sev2 - Quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp on dedicated pool rp-nyc-02. Alert triggered by eval hooks: embedding drift + generation metrics (BLEU/ROUGE drop) crossing thresholds.

leah: I'm on call. pinging SRE and ML. maya can you look at model/quantization profile changes?

sam: saw this alert. Confirming traffic routing: only AcmeCorp traffic hitting rp-nyc-02 right now?

maya: yes, looks tenant-isolated. I see a config change in the quantization profiles that rolled out ~09:12 UTC for that pool: qprofile=v2.3 -> v2.4 (aggressive int8 tweaks).

miguel: who deployed that? docs show qprofile updates are automated from optimize-svc, but should be gated for dedicated pools.

leah: Miguel - can you trace the rollout? if it touched rp-nyc-02 we need immediate mitigation plan.

miguel: digging. optimize-svc deploy logs: 
```
2026-03-15T09:11:40Z optimize-svc: apply qprofile v2.4 to pools: [rp-nyc-02] (auto-suggest)
2026-03-15T09:11:42Z rollout: success
```

maya: regression reproduces locally when running Acme's prompt set against v2.4 quantized model. Quality drop ~12% for ROUGE-L, hallucination rate up.

sam: since it's a tenant-isolated pool, we can revert the qprofile for just rp-nyc-02. That should be low blast radius.

leah: Agreed. Plan: 1) Pin rp-nyc-02 to qprofile v2.3 2) Redirect new requests to fallback model variant if revert takes >5m 3) Notify Acme account team + support 4) Postmortem later.

maya: I can prepare revert command. Reverting to previous quantization profile will also clear candidate kernel cache. Expect brief warmup latency.

sam: I'll run the revert and watch SLOs. Running in canary for the pool first. Commands:
```
# pin qprofile
redwoodctl pools patch rp-nyc-02 --set qprofile=v2.3
# force kernel cache clear (pool-level)
redwoodctl pools exec rp-nyc-02 -- cmd "service runtime clear-kernel-cache"
```

nina: I'll draft a holding message for Acme and include any ETA/backfill options. Need the rollback ETA from SRE/ML.

miguel: Revert executed (09:18 UTC). Can confirm control-plane accepted the patch. Rolling out to all nodes in rp-nyc-02.

leah: Sam, what's the live signal?

sam: Watching generation quality metrics and error rates. Initial after-revert samples look better. Latency spike ~120ms for first few requests then steady. No obvious new errors.

maya: Running the evaluation suite now with Acme prompt set against live pool.

maya: Eval results coming back: ROUGE-L recovered to within 1.5% of baseline, hallucination down to previous baseline. Good.

nina: Draft to Acme (proposed):
"We detected a model quality regression affecting your dedicated pool rp-nyc-02 starting ~09:12 UTC due to an automated quantization profile update. We reverted the profile at 09:18 UTC and quality metrics recovered within minutes. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a detailed postmortem. If you need a rollback window or want us to keep your pool pinned, we can do that."

leah: David (AM) please review before send.

david: LGTM, add "we can enable a manual gate for future qprofile changes for your pool" and offer 1:1 tech sync.

leah: Good. Nina, send with David CC. Mark incident Sev2 and track for 72h for regressions.

nina: Message sent at 09:30 UTC, Acme ops acknowledged, asked for an explanation of why automated rollout hit their dedicated pool.

miguel: Posting followup: optimize-svc autosuggest logic incorrectly classified rp-nyc-02 as eligible for aggressive qprofile because it used global workload fingerprint; we failed to check dedicated-pool exemptions. We'll patch the gating logic.

maya: Action items: 
- hotfix optimize-svc to respect pool exemptions (owner: miguel)
- add dedicated-pool whitelist to rollout service (owner: maya)
- add automated integration test to prevent regressions for tenant-specific evals (owner: maya)
- add manual approval checkbox for any qprofile > v2.3 for Dedicated (owner: product)

leah: Oncall handoff: I'm scheduled until 12:00 UTC. Next oncall sam?

sam: I take over at 12:00 UTC. I'll continue monitoring and run postmortem writeup template.

nina: Customer impact summary for postmortem: "Duration ~6 minutes (09:12-09:18 UTC), affected a single tenant, noticeable quality degradation for generation tasks, no data exfiltration, no latency SLO breach except transient warmup."

maya: Adding evidence: attached eval snippets and diffs (pasted below):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the following legal clause..."
v2.3: "Summary: ..." (accurate)
v2.4: "Summary: ..." (hallucinated extra clause)
```

leah: Great work. Closing notes: keep rp-nyc-02 pinned to v2.3 until optimize-svc gate is in place. Miguel - estimate for patch?

miguel: I can ship a hotfix in ~3 hours, full change with tests EOD.

leah: Sam will monitor until handoff. I'll update incident tracker and schedule postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, owner=leah, incident_id=INC-20260315-0247
